newsitem.title: PERU: Telefonica del Peru sells 51 mln soles at auction.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica del Peru sells 51 mln soles at auction.

text.p: Telefonica del Peru said Friday it sold 50.7 million soles ($19.4 million) worth of short-term commercial debt paper of 80 million soles worth on offer at an auction.

The company sold 14.6 million soles worth of debt with a 30-day maturity at an annual interest rate of between 15.80 percent and 16.49 percent, the company said. Telefonica also sold 36.1 million soles worth of debt with a 90-day maturity at an annual interest rate of between 15.75 percent and 16.50 percent.

The auction was the second issue in Telefonica's three-year global program to issue up to $180 million of commercial paper. The company placed $15 million of a first $50 million offered in December last year.
The issues are intended to increase capital and fund expansion and renovation works. Local brokerages belonging to Banco Wiese and Banco Continental are handling the placements.
Telefonica -- majority-owned by Spain's Telefonica de Espana after its $2.002 billion privatization in 1994 -- is the Lima stock exchange's benchmark stock.
